header: When to use dedicated coordinator nodes
content:
Dedicated coordinator nodes are most beneﬁcial in the following scenarios.
• Large clusters – In environments with a high volume of data or complex queries, oﬄoading
coordination tasks to dedicated nodes can improve cluster performance.
• Frequent queries – Workloads involving frequent search queries or aggregations, especially
those with complex date histograms or multiple aggregations, beneﬁt from faster query
processing.
• Heavy Dashboards use – OpenSearch Dashboards can be resource-intensive. Oﬄoading this
responsibility to dedicated coordinator nodes reduces the strain on data nodes.
